episode_summary: In this episode, Brenton Miebach shares his journey of building a successful real estate business in new markets using paid leads, cold calling, and AI-driven systems. He discusses how he leveraged technology to automate operations and grow his social media presence, offering actionable insights for agents looking to scale their business efficiently.
